card.name: Endings of long drug-class terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long medical word, mostly the ending of drug-class names such as 'antidepressants' and 'tranquilizers' or of 'hypotension'. It appears in drug-interaction and side-effect lists.

modes.label: Drug-class endings
modes.description: Final piece of a drug-class name inside a list of interacting drugs.
modes.example: triptans, tricyclic antidepress<<ants>>, fentanyl, lithium, tramadol

modes.label: Medical term endings
modes.description: Last piece of a side-effect or syndrome term, often before a closing parenthesis.
modes.example: (postural hypot<<ension>>). This can happen more often in people
